patterns.name: verb + noun
patterns.span: おんせん　ばあさん　から　もらった　ふしぎな　ポケモンのタマゴ
patterns.explanation: A phrase ending in a verb placed before a noun describes that noun, like 'that' in English. おんせん　ばあさん　から　もらった　ふしぎな　ポケモンのタマゴ = 'a mysterious Pokémon Egg that was received from the hot-spring old lady'.
